title: Awaitable tests assume lazy task factory (single sleep(0) tick)
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:750, 780: a single 'await asyncio.sleep(0)' makes task.cancelled() True deterministically under the default lazy task factory (mutant-verified on CPython 3.11/3.14), but silently breaks under loop.set_task_factory(asyncio.eager_task_factory) (3.12+ opt-in): probe shows cancelled()=False, ran=[1] — the body runs eagerly and cancellation lands differently. Use a bounded drain loop (e.g. up to 10 ticks until task.cancelled()) in both tests to absorb task-factory and multi-tick delivery assumptions at zero cost.
